raw.rationale: Mitomycin C is a broadly cytotoxic DNA crosslinker activated by reductive enzymes, so at 2.5 µM it kills most cell lines without strong lineage selectivity; modest selective sensitivity is most plausible in hypoxic or high-NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase (NQO1) lineages such as gastric, pancreatic, and upper aerodigestive cancers, while efflux- or repair-proficient lineages are less likely to show lineage-level selective killing.
